entities.summary: Konrad VII the White was a Duke of Oels / Oleśnica, Koźle, half of Bytom and half of Ścinawa during 1416–1427, sole Duke of Koźle and half of Bytom during 1427–1450, Duke of Oleśnica during 1421–1450 and sole Duke of half of Ścinawa during 1447–1450.
